gameos on ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8

running on ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8

adaptation invariants (degraded)

gameos, born on this chip family, running its own real engine AND its own real shell: core.c, gfx.c, input.c, all three games, and the donor's own launcher grid/settings/pause-overlay (registry.c/apps.c/shell.c) all compiled unmodified against a thin compat shim (GOLF's own font and several-megabyte world state each got one declared substitution - see that port's own NOTICE.md), its indexed-framebuffer present pass repainted 28 rows at a time on a device with no framebuffer.
